task.description:
Implement EE-05 (Exclusive Gateway — CEL integration) per the design in `src/design/engine.md §EE-05`.

Read the EE-05 section of the design file in full before writing any code.

Files to modify:
1. `vendor/cel/cel.zig` — implement `cel.evaluate` with the CEL subset defined in the design.
2. `src/engine/transition.zig` — replace the EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY CEL stub with a real `cel.evaluate` call; add new EE-05 unit tests TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-05.

### Implementation notes:

**vendor/cel/cel.zig:**
- Implement the `evaluate(allocator, expression, variables) CelError!bool` function.
- Implement a Pratt/recursive-descent parser for the grammar defined in the design.
- Supported types: bool, i64 (from JSON number), []const u8 (from JSON string).
- Variable access: `variables.<key>` looks up `key` in the ObjectMap. If not found → return `CelError.EvalError`.
- Type mismatch (e.g., comparing string to integer) → return `CelError.EvalError`.
- All memory allocated with the provided allocator.
- No I/O; no filesystem; no network.

**src/engine/transition.zig:**
- Import `vendor/cel/cel.zig` at the top of the file.
- In the `.EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY` branch of `processNodeEntry`, replace the stub condition check:
  ```zig
  // OLD (stub):
  if (std.mem.eql(u8, cond, "true")) { chosen = edge; break; }

  // NEW:
  const match = cel.evaluate(allocator, cond, new_state.variables) catch false;
  if (match) { chosen = edge; break; }
  ```
- Update TC-EE-02-04 through TC-EE-02-06 to use real CEL expressions (e.g., `variables.score > 50`) instead of literal `"true"`/`"false"` strings, so tests exercise the real evaluator.
- Add TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-05 as described in the design.

### Security checklist:
- No SQL in this module — N/A.
- No secrets in source.
- No `catch unreachable` on realistic failure paths.
- CEL parser input is an untrusted string (user-defined condition from definition graph); parser must not panic on malformed input — return `CelError.ParseError` instead.

### Validation:
- `zig build` exits 0
- `zig build test` exits 0 (all existing tests plus TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-05 must pass)
acceptance_criteria: vendor/cel/cel.zig implements evaluate() with the full CEL subset from the design
CelError has ParseError, EvalError, OutOfMemory variants
transition.zig EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY handler uses cel.evaluate(allocator, cond, variables) catch false
TC-EE-02-04 through TC-EE-02-06 updated to use real CEL expressions
TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-05 added and passing

result.summary: Implemented EE-05 (Exclusive Gateway CEL Integration): replaced cel.zig stub with a full recursive-descent CEL evaluator, updated transition.zig EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY handler to call cel.evaluate(), and added TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-05 in tests/unit/test_engine_ee05.zig. All 5 new tests pass. zig build and zig build test both exit 0 (29/29 steps succeeded).
